newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK three-year notes avg accepted yield 6.28 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK three-year notes avg accepted yield 6.28 pct.

text.p: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said the average accepted price of the three-year Exchange Fund notes tendered on Monday was 99.96 yielding 6.28 percent versus 6.44 percent at a previous tender on October 14.
Bids for the HK$500 million issue fell to HK$1.49 billion from HK$7.24 billion at the last tender.
The lowest accepted yield was 6.28 percent while the average tendered yield was 6.29 percent, it said.
The notes carry a coupon of 6.17 percent and mature on January 14, 2000. -- Hong Kong News Room (852) 2843 6369
